title: OncoGFR 1200 — Chemotherapy Dosing by eGFR Equation
text:
A sub-analysis of the dose project using the OncoGFR 1200 cohort, which uniquely includes a measured GFR (mGFR, ⁵¹Cr-EDTA plasma clearance) as the gold standard.
The analysis asks: if chemotherapy were dosed from each estimated-GFR (eGFR) equation instead of measured GFR, how often would patients be over- or under-dosed? Results are presented as heatmaps across equations and drugs, on both indexed (mL/min/1.73 m²) and non-indexed (absolute mL/min) GFR scales.
